mapper.select: SELECT bbd.bill_detail_id as billDetailId, bbd.item_type as itemType, bbd.price, be.employee_name as operateUserName, bti.unit, bti.item_name as itemName FROM base_bill_detail bbd LEFT JOIN base_tariff_info bti ON (bti.item_id = bbd.item_id AND bti.item_type = bbd.item_type) LEFT JOIN base_employee be ON be.user_id = bbd.executor_id WHERE bbd.bill_id = #{billId}

select t.bill_id as billId, if(#{isConsulter} = 0, t.executor_id, t.consulter_id) as executorId, IFNULL(t.price * t.quantity - t.discount_amount, 0) as itemActualAmount, bb.actual_amount AS billActualAmount, bb.received_amount AS billReceivedAmount, t.item_type AS itemType, t.item_id AS itemId from base_bill_detail t left join base_bill bb ON bb.bill_id = t.bill_id
and bb.bill_id in
#{item}
ORDER BY t.item_type

select TRUNCATE(sum(bbd.coupon_workload),2) as makeUpWorkload from base_bill_detail bbd join ( select bb.bill_id from base_bill bb join ( select patient_id from base_patient_origin_log where origin_id = #{originId} and origin_type = #{originType} and inservice = 1 ) t on t.patient_id = bb.patient_id where privilege_date is not null
and DATE_FORMAT( privilege_date, '%Y-%m-%d' ) >= DATE_FORMAT( #{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d' )
and DATE_FORMAT( privilege_date, '%Y-%m-%d' ) <= DATE_FORMAT( #{endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d' )
) t on t.bill_id = bbd.bill_id where bbd.coupon_workload is not null

select * from ( SELECT DISTINCT bb.bill_id billId, bb.patient_id patientId, DATE_FORMAT(t.crt_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') relatedTime, t.`name`, t.mobile, (select DATE_FORMAT(min(treat_start_time), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') from base_treatment_process where patient_id = bb.patient_id and treat_start_time IS NOT NULL) firstVisitDate, (select DATE_FORMAT(max(treat_end_time), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') from base_treatment_process where patient_id = bb.patient_id and treat_start_time IS NOT NULL) lastVisitDate, DATE_FORMAT(bb.order_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') orderDate, bo.abbreviation abbreviation, be.employee_name employeeName, bti.item_name itemName, (((bbd.price * bbd.quantity) - bbd.discount_amount) / bb.actual_amount) workload FROM base_bill_detail bbd LEFT JOIN base_bill bb ON bb.bill_id = bbd.bill_id LEFT JOIN base_tariff_info bti ON bti.item_id = bbd.item_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT log.patient_id, log.crt_time, bp.`name`, bp.mobile, bp.first_visit_date, bp.last_visit_date FROM base_patient_origin_log log JOIN base_bill bb ON log.patient_id = bb.patient_id JOIN base_bill_pay bbp ON bbp.bill_id = bb.bill_id JOIN base_patient bp on bp.patient_id = log.patient_id WHERE log.origin_id = #{originId} AND log.inservice = 1 ) t ON bb.patient_id = t.patient_id LEFT join base_organization bo on bo.org_id = bb.org_id LEFT join base_treatment_process btp on btp.treatment_id = bb.treatment_id LEFT join base_employee be on be.user_id = btp.registered_dentist_id
WHERE bb.bill_id = #{billId} AND bbd.executor_id > 0 AND bti.item_type = bbd.item_type ) t where workload > 0

SELECT bbd.bill_id AS billId, IFNULL( SUM(( bbd.price * bbd.quantity ) - bbd.discount_amount ), 0 ) AS billTotalWorkload, IFNULL( SUM( bbd.coupon_workload ), 0 ) AS billTotalCouponWorkload, bb.org_id AS billOrgId, bb.privilege_org_id AS privilegeOrgId, IFNULL(bb.first_privilege, 0) AS firstPrivilege FROM base_bill_detail bbd INNER JOIN base_bill bb ON bbd.bill_id = bb.bill_id AND bb.bill_date IS NOT NULL
AND bbd.executor_id > 0
AND bbd.executor_id is null
AND bbd.bill_id IN
#{item}
GROUP BY bbd.bill_id

SELECT bbd.bill_id AS billId, SUM( bbd.price * bbd.quantity - bbd.discount_amount ) AS billTotalNotWorkload FROM base_bill_detail bbd
bbd.executor_id is null
AND bbd.bill_id IN
#{item}
GROUP BY bbd.bill_id

SELECT IFNULL( SUM(( bbd.coupon_workload ) ), 0 ) AS totalCouponWorkload FROM base_bill_detail bbd
AND bbd.executor_id > 0 AND bbd.coupon_workload > 0
AND bbd.bill_id IN
#{item}

SELECT bbd.bill_detail_id AS billDetailId, IFNULL((bbd.price * bbd.quantity) - bbd.discount_amount, 0) AS billDetailWorkload, bbd.coupon_workload AS billDetailCouponWorkload FROM base_bill_detail bbd WHERE bbd.executor_id > 0 AND bbd.bill_id = #{billId}

SELECT bbd.bill_detail_id AS billDetailId, IFNULL((bbd.price * bbd.quantity) - bbd.discount_amount, 0) AS billDetailWorkload, bbd.coupon_workload AS billDetailCouponWorkload FROM base_bill_detail bbd WHERE bbd.executor_id IS NULL AND bbd.bill_id = #{billId}
